chunks.answer: Paw & Hearth is an online-only pet supplies brand for cats and dogs. We sell litter boxes, fountains, feeders, home accessories, walking gear, and enrichment toys. We have no retail stores, pharmacy, veterinary service, grooming service, or pet insurance. We do not sell food, treats, medications, live animals, or gift cards. Products and policies in this project describe a fictional demonstration retailer.

chunks.question: About Paw & Hearth

chunks.answer: Most products can be returned within 30 calendar days after delivery. Self-cleaning litter boxes MH-LP50, MH-LP100, and MH-LP200 have a separate 60-calendar-day in-home trial after delivery. Clean, gently tried products with all included parts are accepted; opened or used consumables are excluded from change-of-mind returns. See the Returns and Refunds Policy for eligibility, shipping fees, and exceptions. A policy explanation is not a return approval.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth Shopping FAQ / What is your return policy?
chunks.question: What is your return policy?

chunks.answer: Open the relevant order in My Orders and submit a return/refund request, or contact support through chat or a support ticket. Include the item and reason. Support checks eligibility and provides return authorization and shipping instructions. Do not mail items to an unverified address. chunks.answer: For a different size, color, or model, return the original item under the return policy and place a separate order. Prices and availability for the new order may differ. A replacement for a verified defective, damaged, or incorrect item is handled by support and is subject to availability.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth Shopping FAQ / Do you offer exchanges?
chunks.question: Do you offer exchanges?

chunks.answer: We ship to street addresses in the contiguous 48 U.S. states and Washington, DC. Standard shipping is free on a merchandise subtotal of $49 or more after discounts and rewards, before sales tax. Below $49, standard shipping is $4.95 per order. We do not ship to Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, APO/FPO/DPO addresses, PO boxes, or international addresses. See Billing and Shipping for timing and delivery exceptions.

chunks.answer: In-stock orders normally leave the warehouse in 1-2 business days. Standard transit is estimated at 3-5 business days after carrier pickup. These are separate estimates, not guaranteed arrival dates. Tracking and an actual order lookup are needed for order-specific updates. Weather, holidays, and carrier disruptions can cause delays.

chunks.answer: Our store policy supports Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, Apple Pay, and Google Pay where offered at checkout. All prices and charges are in USD. An itemized receipt is available with the order. The project does not process real payments. Never send full card details or security codes in chat.

chunks.answer: Support can request cancellation or an address correction before warehouse processing starts. An unshipped order may already be processing, so cancellation is not guaranteed. The adjustment window starts at order placement; the return window starts at delivery.

chunks.category: Paw & Hearth Returns and Refunds Policy
chunks.answer:
Request a return within 30 calendar days after delivery for products purchased directly from Paw & Hearth. The delivery date is day 0; the last eligible request date is the delivery date plus 30 calendar days. The request date, not the warehouse receipt date, determines whether the request is within the window. An order placement date or payment date cannot substitute for a missing delivery date.  
Most durable products may be opened and gently tried, but must be clean, free of pet waste and excessive hair, undamaged, and returned with all included parts. Ordinary fit checks are allowed for harnesses, leashes, and beds. Damage from chewing, misuse, or modification is not a change-of-mind return. Normal packaging can be opened; the original box is preferred but equivalent protective packaging is accepted. Missing eligibility facts require clarification or support review, not automatic approval.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth Returns and Refunds Policy / Standard 30-day returns
chunks.question: Standard 30-day returns

chunks.category: Paw & Hearth Returns and Refunds Policy
chunks.answer: MH-LP50, MH-LP100, and MH-LP200 have a 60-calendar-day in-home trial after delivery instead of the standard 30-day window. Delivery is day 0 and the last eligible request date is delivery plus 60 calendar days. A cleaned, gently used litter box can qualify if the cat does not adapt. Remove litter and waste, clean and dry the unit, and include all parts. Consumable litter or filters are not included in the trial. This trial is distinct from the 12-month electronics warranty; it does not extend other products' return windows.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth Returns and Refunds Policy / Self-cleaning litter box 60-day trial
chunks.question: Self-cleaning litter box 60-day trial

chunks.category: Paw & Hearth Returns and Refunds Policy
chunks.answer: Unused, sealed replacement fountain filters, odor cartridges, and waste-bag rolls qualify for standard 30-day returns. Opened or used consumables cannot be returned for change of mind. Defective, damaged, or incorrect consumables still qualify for support review; the sealed-item restriction does not block those claims. No current catalog item is final sale. Any future final-sale exclusion must be explicitly disclosed before purchase. Purchases from another retailer must be handled through that retailer for returns.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth Returns and Refunds Policy / Consumables and exclusions
chunks.question: Consumables and exclusions

chunks.category: Paw & Hearth Returns and Refunds Policy
chunks.answer: Request help through My Orders, chat, or a support ticket, identifying the order, item, reason, delivery date, and condition. Support verifies ownership and eligibility, then provides return authorization and a prepaid label where applicable. Ship the authorized return within 14 calendar days after authorization. Contact support if the label expires or the deadline cannot be met; exceptions require review. Do not send an item before receiving instructions or invent a return address. Use protective packaging and retain the carrier receipt.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth Returns and Refunds Policy / Return authorization and dispatch
chunks.question: Return authorization and dispatch

chunks.category: Paw & Hearth Returns and Refunds Policy
chunks.answer:
For change-of-mind or fit returns, the prepaid label fee deducted from the refund is $4.95 per authorized return shipment for standard items, or $25 per authorized return shipment containing a self-cleaning litter box. The $25 fee replaces, rather than adds to, the $4.95 fee for that shipment. Support confirms grouping and the fee before authorization; separately authorized shipments can incur separate fees. There is no additional restocking fee. Original outbound shipping is not refunded for a change-of-mind return. We do not retroactively charge outbound shipping when a partial return drops the kept merchandise below $49.  
For a verified defective, transit-damaged, incorrect, or missing item, Paw & Hearth covers necessary return shipping and does not deduct a return-label fee. A missing item does not require mailing back an item never received. If the entire order is returned because of our verified error or a verified defect, original outbound shipping is also refunded. On a partial error/defect return, the original outbound shipping charge remains unless support approves an adjustment.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth Returns and Refunds Policy / Return shipping fees
chunks.question: Return shipping fees

chunks.category: Paw & Hearth Returns and Refunds Policy
chunks.answer:
After the return is delivered to our warehouse, inspection and refund issuance normally take 3-5 business days. After issuance, the payment provider may need another 5-10 business days to post the credit. These are estimates, not guarantees, and neither period starts when the return request is submitted. An approved cancellation with no return shipment normally has its refund issued within 3-5 business days after cancellation confirmation, followed by the same estimated bank posting period.  
Refunds go to the original payment method. Refundable merchandise value is the amount actually paid for the returned items after allocated discounts, plus applicable refunded sales tax, less any disclosed return-label fee. Refunds do not exceed the original amount paid. Bundled merchandise uses the order's allocated line-item prices, not undiscounted retail prices. Earned or redeemed rewards are handled under Paw Points and Promotions. A request, authorization, warehouse receipt, refund issuance, and bank posting are separate events; do not claim a later event without evidence.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth Returns and Refunds Policy / Refund amounts and timing
chunks.question: Refund amounts and timing

chunks.category: Paw & Hearth Returns and Refunds Policy
chunks.answer: We do not offer direct size, color, or model exchanges. Return the original item and place a separate new order. Support may approve a same-item replacement for a verified defect, damage, or fulfillment error, subject to stock. Do not promise a substitute, replacement shipment, or refund until approved. Returnless refunds or donations are exceptions only when support explicitly authorizes them.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth Returns and Refunds Policy / Exchanges and replacements
chunks.question: Exchanges and replacements

chunks.category: Paw & Hearth Returns and Refunds Policy
chunks.answer: Contact support as soon as a delivery problem is discovered. We recommend reporting within 7 calendar days after delivery so we can investigate promptly; this is not a hard cutoff that automatically voids return or warranty eligibility. Keep the packaging and provide photos of the item and shipping label if available. An unboxing video is not required. Support determines whether a replacement, return, or refund is appropriate. Do not ask a customer to operate a damaged electrical device for proof.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth Returns and Refunds Policy / Damaged, incorrect, or missing items
chunks.question: Damaged, incorrect, or missing items

chunks.category: Paw & Hearth Returns and Refunds Policy
chunks.answer: The return and trial windows address eligible returns; warranty covers qualifying defects for 12 months after delivery for powered products. A defect reported after the return window can still qualify for warranty service. Consumables, ordinary wear, chewing, and accidental damage are not covered by the electronics warranty. See the After-Sales and Product Support Guide. These store policies do not limit rights that apply under law; questions about such rights require human review.

chunks.question: Returns versus warranty

chunks.category: Paw & Hearth After-Sales and Product Support Guide
chunks.answer:
Use the chat's human-support option or submit a support ticket from the order or ticket area. An AI assistant may explain policies, look up authorized order information, and help prepare a request. Human chat handoff and support tickets are separate services; creating a ticket does not connect a live agent. Do not invent a phone number, email address, mobile app, repair-center address, or store location.  
Human-support hours are Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m.-6:00 p.m. America/Los_Angeles (Pacific Time, observing daylight saving time), excluding U.S. federal holidays. Requests can be submitted at any time. We aim for a first human response within 1 business day; this is a service target, not a guaranteed queue or resolution time. Weekend and holiday submissions are reviewed the next business day. The demo queue does not enforce business hours or simulate guaranteed staffing.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth After-Sales and Product Support Guide / Contacting human support
chunks.question: Contacting human support

chunks.category: Paw & Hearth After-Sales and Product Support Guide
chunks.answer: Provide the order number, affected model, problem description, and relevant photos if available. Device troubleshooting may require the serial number, but never a password or payment security code. Support must verify order ownership before sharing order details or authorizing a change. If more than one order or product could match, ask which one. A photo can help investigate; an unboxing video is not a mandatory condition.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth After-Sales and Product Support Guide / What information support needs
chunks.question: What information support needs

chunks.category: Paw & Hearth After-Sales and Product Support Guide
chunks.answer:
All powered catalog products have a 12-month limited warranty from delivery for defects in materials or workmanship during normal household use. Powered models are MH-LP50, MH-LP100, MH-LP200, MH-W20, MH-W40, MH-W60, MH-HP12, MH-HP20, MH-FD10, MH-FD30, and MH-CAM1. A replacement receives the remainder of the original warranty or 90 calendar days from replacement delivery, whichever is longer. Keep the order receipt; a missing delivery date requires review.  
The warranty excludes normal wear, consumables, chewing, accidental damage, unauthorized modifications, and liquid damage caused by use contrary to the model's cleaning instructions. Nonpowered beds, harnesses, leashes, bowls, toys, and cat furniture do not have this electronics warranty; verified defects still go to support for review under the return policy and any applicable rights. Do not infer warranty eligibility from a product name or order status alone.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth After-Sales and Product Support Guide / Limited electronics warranty
chunks.question: Limited electronics warranty

chunks.category: Paw & Hearth After-Sales and Product Support Guide
chunks.answer: Support first troubleshoots the issue and verifies eligibility. An approved claim may be resolved with a replacement part, repair, or replacement unit, at support's direction and subject to availability. Paw & Hearth pays standard shipping both ways for approved warranty service at supported U.S. addresses. Obtain authorization before shipping. Repair turnaround depends on diagnosis and parts; there is no fixed completion deadline. Out-of-warranty repair requires a quoted fee and customer approval before work begins. There is no paid warranty-extension plan.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth After-Sales and Product Support Guide / Warranty service and repair shipping
chunks.question: Warranty service and repair shipping

chunks.category: Paw & Hearth After-Sales and Product Support Guide
chunks.answer: Stop using and unplug a device if safe to do so when there is smoke, a burning smell, a damaged cord, unexpected motion, or overheating. Keep pets away and contact human support. Do not recommend repeated restarts or bypassing a safety sensor in these circumstances. The assistant cannot diagnose a pet's injury or illness; direct health concerns to a veterinarian. Do not claim a product is escape-proof, chew-proof, medically therapeutic, or certified to a standard absent evidence.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth After-Sales and Product Support Guide / Electrical and product safety concerns
chunks.question: Electrical and product safety concerns

chunks.category: Paw & Hearth After-Sales and Product Support Guide
chunks.answer: MH-LP100 and MH-LP200 support the Paw & Hearth device app on 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi; MH-LP50 has no Wi-Fi or app features. The device app is a fictional product feature, separate from this project's customer-support website. Use only the documented cat weight range and use manual mode for kittens under 6 months. Place the unit on a firm, level floor. For a routine full-bin alert, empty and reinstall the bin with power disconnected. If motion or sensor behavior seems unsafe, discontinue use and contact support rather than bypassing safeguards.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth After-Sales and Product Support Guide / Litter box setup and troubleshooting
chunks.question: Litter box setup and troubleshooting

chunks.category: Paw & Hearth After-Sales and Product Support Guide
chunks.answer: For MH-W20, MH-W40, and MH-W60, unplug before cleaning, check water above the minimum line, and inspect the removable pump intake for debris. Clean the bowl and pump weekly; replace the model-specific filter every 2-4 weeks, sooner if visibly dirty. Never submerge a power adapter or a component not marked washable. If a cord or pump is damaged, stop use and contact support. Filters for MH-W20 and MH-W40/MH-W60 are different and are not interchangeable.

chunks.answer: MH-FD10 is an offline scheduled feeder. MH-FD30 and MH-CAM1 use 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi; 5 GHz-only networks are unsupported. Food portions vary with kibble; measure actual output rather than promising grams per portion. Check power and network settings for routine connectivity issues, and never ask for the Wi-Fi password in chat. Neither feeder guarantees feeding during an extended outage.

chunks.answer: For MH-DH20 harnesses, measure the dog's chest at the widest point behind the front legs and use the size chart. A dog's weight or breed is insufficient to select a size. chunks.category: Paw & Hearth Paw Points and Promotions
chunks.answer: Paw Points is a free, optional rewards program for registered customers. There are no paid tiers, annual fees, automatic upgrades, priority human-support guarantees, or membership-specific shipping allowances. Joining does not enroll the customer in recurring shipments. Rewards balances and redemption require a verified account; the assistant cannot invent a balance.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth Paw Points and Promotions / Free membership and eligibility
chunks.question: Free membership and eligibility

chunks.category: Paw & Hearth Paw Points and Promotions
chunks.answer: Earn 1 point for each whole $1 actually paid for eligible merchandise after coupons and rewards. Calculate points on the eligible order merchandise subtotal and round down once per order: $24.99 earns 24 points. Shipping, sales tax, refunded amounts, and the portion paid with rewards earn no points. Points post 14 calendar days after the last package in the order is delivered. Returned merchandise reverses its associated earned points; a reversal can produce a negative balance, which future earnings offset.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth Paw Points and Promotions / Earning points
chunks.question: Earning points

chunks.category: Paw & Hearth Paw Points and Promotions
chunks.answer: Redeem 100 points for a $5 merchandise discount, in increments of 100 points, up to 300 points ($15) per order. A $5 redemption requires at least $5 of remaining eligible merchandise after coupons; a $10 redemption requires at least $10, and a $15 redemption at least $15. Rewards cannot pay for shipping or tax and have no cash value. The $49 free-shipping threshold is calculated after the reward discount, so redeeming points can make shipping payable. Rewards cannot be transferred to another account.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth Paw Points and Promotions / Redeeming points
chunks.question: Redeeming points

chunks.category: Paw & Hearth Paw Points and Promotions
chunks.answer: Unused earned points expire 12 months after they post; oldest points are redeemed first. On a full order refund, all redeemed points are restored. For a partial refund, the order's recorded line-item reward allocation determines the restored points; do not guess the allocation. Restored redeemed points keep their original expiration or remain valid for 30 calendar days after restoration, whichever is later. Refunds return only the amount actually paid for items; rewards are restored as points rather than cash. Support handles missing points and allocation disputes.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth Paw Points and Promotions / Expiration and returns
chunks.question: Expiration and returns

chunks.category: Paw & Hearth Paw Points and Promotions
chunks.answer: One promotional code may be used per order. A valid code can be combined with Paw Points, subject to its disclosed eligible items, minimum spend, and expiration. Code minimum spend is measured on eligible merchandise before that code's discount and before rewards, excluding shipping and tax. Promotions apply only while valid and do not guarantee future availability or restocking. Do not invent a welcome discount or coupon code. There is no blanket rule that every offer stacks with every sale.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth Paw Points and Promotions / Coupons and promotions
chunks.question: Coupons and promotions

chunks.category: Paw & Hearth Paw Points and Promotions
chunks.answer: A one-time own-store price adjustment may be requested within 7 calendar days after order placement for an identical model and variant. Clearance, flash sales, coupon-only offers, bundles, and competitor pricing are excluded. Support verifies the original paid price and qualifying lower price before approving a refund of the difference and any applicable tax adjustment. Redeemed points are not paid out as cash. The 7-day adjustment period starts at order placement, not delivery.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth Paw Points and Promotions / Price adjustments
chunks.question: Price adjustments

chunks.category: Paw & Hearth Paw Points and Promotions
chunks.answer: Paw & Hearth does not offer Autoship, automatic replenishment, recurring charges, paid memberships, or birthday gifts. This demo describes the intended rewards policy, but has no rewards ledger, redemption checkout, or payment integration. Support may explain these rules or record a question; it cannot claim to credit points, apply a coupon, change a subscription, or complete a price adjustment without an implemented tool and verified success.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth Paw Points and Promotions / Subscription and account limits
chunks.question: Subscription and account limits

chunks.answer: All store prices, shipping charges, discounts, and refunds are in U.S. dollars (USD). Listed merchandise prices exclude sales tax. Applicable sales tax is calculated at checkout based on the shipping destination and items. There is no universal sales-tax rate in this knowledge base. Prices and stock are operational data, not fixed policy: quote them only from a current USD-configured product or order record. Do not convert an old CNY demo amount by relabeling it USD. An unknown price or stock level must remain unknown.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth Billing and Shipping / Currency, prices, and stock
chunks.question: Currency, prices, and stock

chunks.answer: Accepted store-policy payment methods are Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, Apple Pay, and Google Pay where displayed at checkout. We do not offer buy-now-pay-later financing, checks, wire transfers, cash on delivery, or gift cards. A failed payment does not establish a completed order. A pending bank authorization is not proof that a settled charge or duplicate charge occurred; support must investigate. Never request full card numbers, CVV codes, passwords, or one-time login codes in chat or tickets.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth Billing and Shipping / Payment and payment privacy
chunks.question: Payment and payment privacy

chunks.answer: Order confirmation and itemized receipts show merchandise, discounts, shipping, sales tax, and order total. Customers can view their order details or ask support for help obtaining a receipt. We do not issue VAT invoices or require a tax identification number for an itemized receipt. A suspected duplicate charge requires a verified order and payment review; do not promise a refund solely from a screenshot or a pending authorization.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth Billing and Shipping / Receipts and billing questions
chunks.question: Receipts and billing questions

chunks.answer: Delivery is available only to street addresses in the contiguous 48 U.S. states and Washington, DC. Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, APO/FPO/DPO military addresses, PO boxes, and international addresses are unsupported. There is no physical store pickup or same-day delivery. Support cannot override an unsupported destination or quote an undocumented remote-area surcharge.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth Billing and Shipping / Shipping destinations
chunks.question: Shipping destinations

chunks.answer: Standard shipping is free when the order's merchandise subtotal is at least $49 after all merchandise discounts and Paw Points rewards, before sales tax. Otherwise standard shipping is $4.95 per order. All current catalog products qualify; there is no oversized-item or rural-area surcharge for supported addresses. The fee is per order even if we split it into multiple packages. Example: $52 minus a $5 reward leaves $47 of merchandise, so $4.95 shipping applies. Sales tax does not count toward the threshold.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth Billing and Shipping / Standard shipping charges
chunks.question: Standard shipping charges

chunks.answer: In-stock orders normally ship in 1-2 business days after payment confirmation. Standard transit is estimated at 3-5 business days after carrier pickup. Neither estimate is a guaranteed delivery date. Business days are Monday-Friday, excluding U.S. federal holidays; the human-support schedule is separate. Weekends do not count toward processing, transit, or refund business-day estimates. Do not promise a particular arrival date without verified order-specific evidence.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth Billing and Shipping / Processing, transit, and business days
chunks.question: Processing, transit, and business days

chunks.answer: Tracking becomes available after the carrier receives shipment information; a label-created status does not prove carrier pickup. A split order may have multiple tracking numbers and delivery dates without an extra shipping fee. Check each package before treating an item as missing. Carrier choice and stock must come from order data; no carrier is guaranteed in advance. If tracking has not updated for 3 business days after carrier pickup, contact support for investigation. This is a contact guideline, not a refund deadline.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth Billing and Shipping / Tracking, split shipments, and delays
chunks.question: Tracking, split shipments, and delays

chunks.answer: Cancellation or address correction may be requested before warehouse processing starts, but is not guaranteed. Unshipped does not necessarily mean editable. Once processing starts or a package is handed to the carrier, support must review available options. Delivered orders use the return policy. Item quantities or variants cannot be edited in an existing order; an approved cancellation and a new order may be needed. A cancellation request is distinct from confirmed cancellation.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth Billing and Shipping / Address changes and cancellations
chunks.question: Address changes and cancellations

chunks.answer: Check the delivery location, household, neighbors or building office where appropriate, and any carrier delivery photo. If the package is still missing, contact support with the order number. Support investigates carrier scans and may approve a replacement or refund after review. There is no automatic replacement, police-report requirement, or guaranteed carrier-claim resolution time in this policy.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth Billing and Shipping / Delivered but not received
chunks.question: Delivered but not received

chunks.answer: We do not accept backorders or preorders. If an ordered item becomes unavailable before fulfillment, support contacts the customer about cancellation and refund of that item, including any applicable tax. We do not substitute a different model without consent. There is no guaranteed restock date or implemented restock-notification service.
chunks.section_path: Paw & Hearth Billing and Shipping / Out-of-stock products
chunks.question: Out-of-stock products
